about: Shared parts: option sets several events use ("use" in an event), and consequences several events schedule.

flood.about: Floods and storms: insure, prepare or do nothing, for the next ten years. Whether one reaches you comes from the real yearly rate where you live (hazards in js/engine.js, EM-DAT); this card sets how much of the damage you pay (prot). aid: government aid when hit (× typical wage); prem: yearly premium; prep: cost of preparing.

ready.do: prot = {lv: k, until: age + 10, aid: aid || 0, id: id}; if (k === 2) { T(id, {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.floodIns'), paid: 0, saved: 0, nk: 'note.floodIns'}); rec(id, prem * base, 10) } if (k === 1) spend(id + 'P', prep * base, 'trk.floodPrep')

en..cover.h: About a {p}% chance a flood or storm reaches you in the next ten years; the insurer pays most of the damage.
en..prep.s: Raise furniture and sockets, keep sandbags: about {a} once.
en..prep.h: About a {p}% chance of a flood or storm in the next ten years; being ready halves the damage.
en..none.h: About a {p}% chance of a flood or storm in the next ten years.

zh..cover.h: 未来十年大约有{p}%的机会遇上水灾或风灾；保险会赔大部分损失。
zh..prep.s: 把家具和插座垫高，备好沙包：一次约{a}。
zh..prep.h: 未来十年大约有{p}%的机会遇上水灾或风灾；有准备的话损失减半。
zh..none.h: 未来十年大约有{p}%的机会遇上水灾或风灾。

zht..cover.h: 未來十年大約有{p}%的機會遇上水災或風災；保險會賠大部分損失。
zht..prep.s: 把家具和插座墊高，備好沙包：一次約{a}。
zht..prep.h: 未來十年大約有{p}%的機會遇上水災或風災；有準備的話損失減半。
zht..none.h: 未來十年大約有{p}%的機會遇上水災或風災。

rosca.about: A savings group (ROSCA): pay a yearly amount a (× typical wage) for n years; take the pot early (× early) or late (× late, with a small risk that someone stops paying and you get half). draw: the turn is drawn by lot.

let.v: {a: MN(amt), b: MN(amt * n * early), c: MN(amt * n * late), n: n}

join.do: const t = T(id, {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.rosca'), paid: 0, saved: 0, nk: 'note.rosca'}); rec(id, amt, n); if (turn === 'early') { const w = amt * n * early; cash += w; t.v += w; t.saved = w; t.note = M('note.rosca', {a: MN(0), b: MN(w)}) } else later(age + n, 'rosca', {id: id, pot: amt * n, m: late, risk: risk})

later.rosca: const t = trk[x.id], bad = roll('rosca' + x.id) < x.risk, v = x.pot * x.m * (bad ? .5 : 1); cash += v; if (t) { t.v += v; t.saved = (t.saved || 0) + v; t.note = M('note.rosca', { a: MN(t.paid || 0), b: MN(t.saved) }); } if (bad) rl(-3); log(M(bad ? 'log.roscaBad' : 'log.roscaOk', { a: MN(v) }), bad ? 'bad' : 'good')

en..early.s: Get the pot now, about {b}, then keep paying {a} a year for {n:a year|# years}.
en..late.s: Pay {a} a year for {n:a year|# years}, then collect about {c}.
en..late.h: About a {p}% chance someone stops paying and you get only half.
en..join.s: Pay {a} a year for {n:a year|# years}; your turn for the pot is drawn by lot.
en..join.h: About a {p}% chance someone stops paying and the group pays out less.

zh..early.s: 现在拿到约{b}，之后每年继续交{a}，共{n}年。
zh..late.s: 每年交{a}，共{n}年，最后拿回约{c}。
zh..late.h: 大约{p}%的机会有人中途不交，你只拿回一半。
zh..join.s: 每年交{a}，共{n}年；轮到谁拿会钱靠抽签。
zh..join.h: 大约{p}%的机会有人中途不交，大家拿回的会少一些。

zht..early.s: 現在拿到約{b}，之後每年繼續交{a}，共{n}年。
zht..late.s: 每年交{a}，共{n}年，最後拿回約{c}。
zht..late.h: 大約{p}%的機會有人中途不交，你只拿回一半。
zht..join.s: 每年交{a}，共{n}年；輪到誰拿會錢靠抽籤。
zht..join.h: 大約{p}%的機會有人中途不交，大家拿回的會少一些。

infl.about: Very high inflation: money left in a local bank account loses a share f ([from, to]) of its value next year. usd: the text naming the dollar account.

opts.do: const t = T(id, {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.infl')}); const fe = .02 * Math.max(0, cash); cash -= fe; t.v -= fe; later(age + 1, 'infl', {id: id, f: inR(fx, [-.04, .05])})
putIn(id + 'S', .5 * Math.max(0, cash), {}, 'trk.inflStock'); later(age + 1, 'infl', {id: id, f: lose})

later.infl: inflYr = age; const t = T(x.id, { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.infl') }), d = -x.f * Math.max(0, cash); cash += d; t.v += d; t.note = M(d < 0 ? 'note.inflLoss' : 'note.inflOk', { a: MN(Math.abs(d)) }); log(M(d < 0 ? 'log.inflLoss' : 'log.inflOk', { a: MN(Math.abs(d)) }), d < 0 ? 'bad' : 'good')

en..keep.s: The interest is far below the rise in prices.
en..keep.h: Your savings could lose {a}–{b}% of their value this year.
en..usd.s: Put your savings into {x}; changing money costs about {a}.
en..et: gold, which keeps its value as the birr falls
en..stock.s: Put {a} into shares on the local stock exchange; keep the rest in the bank.

zh..keep.s: 利息远远赶不上物价上涨。
zh..keep.h: 今年你的存款可能贬值{a}–{b}%。
zh..et: 黄金，比尔贬值时它能保值
zh..stock.s: 把{a}买成本地交易所的股票，其余留在银行。

zht..keep.s: 利息遠遠趕不上物價上漲。
zht..keep.h: 今年你的存款可能貶值{a}–{b}%。
zht..et: 黃金，比爾貶值時它能保值
zht..stock.s: 把{a}買成本地交易所的股票，其餘留在銀行。

m13.about: A bonus month by law (13th-month pay, THR, aguinaldo): how to use it. m: share of a year's pay.

opts.do: const p = Math.min(a, debt, Math.max(0, cash)); debt -= p; cash -= p; happy += 1

en..debt.s: Up to {a} off what you owe.
en..treat.s: Gifts, a feast and a trip: {a}. Happiness +3.

zh..treat.s: 礼物、大餐和一趟旅行：{a}。幸福感 +3。

zht..treat.s: 禮物、大餐和一趟旅行：{a}。幸福感 +3。

ctr.about: A contract abroad: pay × m for yrs years, living costs × cm (below 1 when the employer houses you), a fee up front (× typical wage); remit: money sent home each year (× typical wage).

opts.do: contract(id, {m: m, cm: cm, yrs: yrs, fee: f, remit: remit})
contract(id, {m: m, cm: cm, yrs: yrs, fee: f, remit: r})

en..go.s: Pay of about {a} a year (you earn {b} now) for {n:a year|# years}. Fees and travel: {f}. Far from home: Happiness −3.
en..send.s: The same contract, and you send about {r} a year to your family. Happiness −3.
en..stay.s: Keep your job and your life here.

zh..go.s: 年薪约{a}（你现在是{b}），为期{n}年。中介费和路费：{f}。远离家乡：幸福感 −3。
zh..send.s: 同样的合约，每年寄约{r}给家人。幸福感 −3。
zh..stay.s: 保住这里的工作和生活。

zht..go.s: 年薪約{a}（你現在是{b}），為期{n}年。中介費和路費：{f}。遠離家鄉：幸福感 −3。
zht..send.s: 同樣的合約，每年寄約{r}給家人。幸福感 −3。
zht..stay.s: 保住這裡的工作和生活。

exam.about: A public exam for a government job: chance is the base chance to pass (Skill adds to it); a full year of unpaid leave to study, or study part-time.

sit.do: pay(fee); const t = T(id, {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.exam')}); t.v -= fee + (full ? Math.max(0, salary()) : 0); t.note = M('note.examIn'); if (full) offUntil = age + 1; else happy -= 2; later(age + 1, 'exam', {id: id, p: q})

later.exam: const t = trk[x.id]; if (!job || retired) return; if (roll('exam' + x.id) < x.p) { endCareer('quit', age - 1); pickCareer('civ'); if (t) t.note = M('note.examOk'); log(M('log.examOk'), 'good'); } else { happy -= 3; if (t) t.note = M('note.examNo'); log(M('log.examNo'), 'bad'); }

en..full: Take a year off to study
en..full.s: A year of unpaid leave (you give up {a} of pay) and a prep course of about {b}.
en..part.s: A prep course of about {b}, and tired evenings. Happiness −2.
en..no.s: Keep your career as it is.

zh..full.s: 停薪一年（少赚{a}），再加约{b}的培训班。
zh..part.s: 培训班约{b}，晚上很累。幸福感 −2。

zht..full.s: 停薪一年（少賺{a}），再加約{b}的補習班。
zht..part.s: 補習班約{b}，晚上很累。幸福感 −2。

later.repay: const pb = x.pid ? bondOf(x.pid) : null, q1 = pb != null ? clamp(.45 + (pb - 50) * .004, 0, .95) : relP(.45), q2 = pb != null ? clamp(.65 + (pb - 50) * .004, 0, .95) : relP(.65); const u = roll('repay' + x.id), f = x.fam ? u < .7 ? 1 : u < .85 ? .5 : 0 : u < q1 ? 1 : u < q2 ? .5 : 0, v = x.a * f; cash += v; const t = trk[x.id]; if (t) { t.v += v; t.note = M('note.repay', { a: MN(x.a), b: MN(v) }); } if (pb != null) bond(x.pid, f === 1 ? 4 : f ? 0 : -10); log(M((x.fam ? 'log.kidRepay' : 'log.repay') + (f === 1 ? 'All' : f ? 'Half' : 'None'), { a: MN(x.a), b: MN(v) }), f === 1 ? 'good' : 'bad')
later.scam: const t = trk[x.id]; if (t) t.note = M('note.scam', { a: MN(x.a) }); log(M(x.k2 ? 'log.scam2' : 'log.scam', { a: MN(x.a) }), 'bad')
later.sideBiz: if (roll('side' + x.id) < x.p) { T(x.id, { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.sideBiz') }); rec(x.id, -x.a, x.n); log(M('log.sideBiz'), 'good'); }
